name: replace-doodads-hillsbrad
description: test.md 'Replace Doodads FTtw to LTcr on HillsbradCreek': smoketest_maps HillsbradCreek, Replace Doodads FTtw (Herbstliches Lordaeron, Trees/Destructibles, first row) to LTcr in every doodad. Measured 2026-11-16 (branch we-package-specials-camps): the editor says '94 doodads could not be replaced in their current locations' in the view's text. Studio: w3.terrain.replaceDoodads. Counts: 2786 FTtw in the map; the editor replaced 2692 (94 left, matching its message), Studio 2701 (85 left): nine FTtw at (7616,3648) (7104,3776) (7232,3648) (5952,3520) (6336,3520) (7168,5568) (7104,5440) (7552,5568) (7808,5440), all angle 4.71, the editor kept and Studio replaced. Cause found 2026-11-16 (branch replace-doodads-we): a large rock's no-build (blue) corners count against the crate, which touches only its red part; Studio has the rule since, and the spec expects a match; the new variation is random in the editor when the old type had more (0 and 1 stay), so variation is ignored, and the file's format version (the editor writes 13, Studio keeps the input's 8 with skin ids).

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); const loaded = () => (s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length ?? 0) > 0; for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !loaded(); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); if (!loaded()) throw new Error('the doodads were not loaded'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); const n = await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.replaceDoodads', { from: 'FTtw', to: 'LTcr' }); console.log('STUDIO_REPLACED ' + n); if (!(n >= 1)) throw new Error('replaced ' + n); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await w3.editors.saveAll();
